definitions.name: raw source records
definitions.meaning: issues + pull requests + ALL comments, as retrieved (stored internally with provenance)

definitions.name: context-only comments
definitions.meaning: comments on issues other than the submission thread (#1); stored, never treated as submissions

definitions.name: normalised records
definitions.meaning: issues + pull requests + submission-thread comments; one per source record that the normaliser processed

definitions.name: submission-type records
definitions.meaning: normalised records whose intent is submission or submission_unclear (the 'relevant addition requests')

definitions.name: placed records
definitions.meaning: submission-type records with a usable identity (repository, package or endpoint); each is in exactly one project

definitions.name: unplaced records
definitions.meaning: submission-type records with no extractable identity; listed for manual review, not candidates

definitions.name: projects / canonical candidates
definitions.meaning: groups of placed records sharing one canonical identity; the unit that is evaluated, reviewed and may be published

definitions.name: duplicate records
definitions.meaning: placed records that are not the first record of their project (= placed records - projects)

definitions.name: multi-record projects
definitions.meaning: projects with more than one record; the R1 (GitHub identity) and R4 (endpoint/package identity) merge entries are one per such project

definitions.name: R2/R3/R5/R6 merge entries
definitions.meaning: one entry per record that was linked (R2 package, R3 endpoint, R5 package) or re-keyed by a rename (R6); NOT merge operations

definitions.name: rename mappings
definitions.meaning: repositories whose GitHub-resolved owner/name differs from the submitted one (197); NOT the number of merges

definitions.name: records re-keyed by rename
definitions.meaning: records whose repository key was replaced because of a rename (R6 entries)

definitions.name: projects joined by rename
definitions.meaning: multi-record projects whose records carried different original repo keys that a rename made equal (the only places a rename caused a merge)

definitions.name: ambiguous projects
definitions.meaning: distinct projects with a review-relevant ambiguity flag (monorepo_subpath_project excluded); a project can carry several flags

definitions.name: N6 reason entries vs projects
definitions.meaning: N6 is recorded once per ambiguity flag, so entries (246) exceed distinct projects (196)

definitions.name: eligible / needs_review / ineligible
definitions.meaning: machine category; exactly one per project; a partition of all projects

definitions.name: importable
definitions.meaning: candidate can be stored with provenance and is not on the suppression list

definitions.name: eligible_unblocked
definitions.meaning: eligible and no security flag and no removal hold; may enter the approval queue (bulk-capable lane); NOT approved

definitions.name: approved_for_publication
definitions.meaning: human decision recorded and all publication gates passed; the pipeline never sets this (always 0 here)

content_rights.note: Rights review has not been performed for any record (policy: import-eligibility-policy.md section 6).

checks.name: T0a raw issues file lines = collected issues
T0b raw pull-request file lines = collected pull requests
T0c raw comment file lines = collected comments
T0d comments on the submission thread in the raw file = thread comments normalised
T1 raw source records = normalised records + context-only comments
T2 normalised records = issues + PRs + submission-thread comments
T2b thread-comment count agrees between normalise and classify
T3 normalised records = sum of intents
T4 normalised records = submission-type + non-submission
T4b non-submission records agree between normalise and classify
T5 submission-type records = placed + unplaced
T5b submission-type = submission + submission_unclear
T6 placed records = projects + duplicate records
T6b placed records = single-record projects + records inside multi-record projects
T6c records inside multi-record projects = multi-record projects + duplicate records
T7 duplicate records = sum of duplicate records by basis
T8 multi-record projects = R1 + R4 entries (project-level labels)
T8b multi-record projects = sum by identity type
T8c dedup projects = classification projects
T9 projects joined by rename <= projects containing renamed records
T9b projects joined by rename <= multi-record projects
T9c R6 entries (records re-keyed) agree between summaries
T10 projects = eligible + needs_review + ineligible
T10b needs_review = sum by first rule
T10c ineligible = sum by rule
T11 ambiguous projects agree between dedup and classify
T11b ambiguous projects = sum of ambiguous projects by category
T11c no ambiguous project is eligible
T12 eligible = eligible_unblocked + security-only + hold-only + both
T13 eligible_unblocked <= importable
T13b importable <= projects
T13c importable + suppressed = projects
T14 approved_for_publication <= eligible_unblocked
T15 approval lanes cover every project
T15b bulk + individual + family_sample = eligible_unblocked
T15c blocked lane = eligible - eligible_unblocked
T15d needs_review lane = needs_review category
T15e not_eligible lane = ineligible category
T15f eligible by evidence level = eligible
